task.title: P6-138: Fix debounced-read vs immediate-Enter race that adds a term the user did not type
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-138. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**Debounced-read / immediate-Enter race in the set picker adds a term the user did not type** (was `P6-036e`). `CommandInput` sets `ctx.query` synchronously per keystroke (`command.rs:302`) while the row list re-keys 250 ms later (`rail.rs:966-973`) and `should_filter = false` keeps stale rows "visible" — so typing toward "limited edition alpha" and pressing Enter mid-window adds `s:leb` rather than `s:lea`. Visible and removable, but wrong.
